target: forge.sh kind — absent, malformed or unreadable .agentic/config.json is no config and resolution continues
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k() { fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
k absent
mkdir -p .agentic; printf '{not json at all' > .agentic/config.json
k malformed
rm .agentic/config.json; mkdir .agentic/config.json
k directory
rmdir .agentic/config.json; printf '{"forge":{"kind":' > .agentic/config.json
k truncated
fx_done
